aboutMachining.title: Understanding Machining
aboutMachining.description: Machining is a manufacturing process that uses machine tools to transform raw materials into components with precise dimensions and tolerances. This process involves removing material from a workpiece to achieve the desired shape, size, and surface finish.

highlights.title: CNC Machining
highlights.description: Computer Numerical Control enables high precision and consistent reproducibility.

highlights.title: Precision Tolerances
highlights.description: Achieving tolerances up to Â±0.001mm for critical applications.

highlights.title: Quality Control
highlights.description: CMM inspection and rigorous documentation at every stage.

aboutFabrikasi.title: Understanding Fabrication
aboutFabrikasi.description: Fabrication is the process of converting raw materials into finished products or ready-to-use components through various processes such as cutting, bending, welding, and assembly. Unlike machining which focuses on material removal, fabrication emphasizes forming and assembly.

highlights.title: Cutting & Shaping
highlights.description: Precision cutting using laser, plasma, or waterjet.

highlights.title: Welding & Joining
highlights.description: MIG, TIG, and SMAW welding for solid structures.

highlights.title: Bending & Forming
highlights.description: Bending and forming of plates and steel profiles.

highlights.title: Assembly
highlights.description: Component assembly into ready-to-install final products.

methods.title: Our Capabilities
methods.subtitle: We employ various machining methods to produce components with the best quality and precision for your needs.

items.title: Milling
items.description: Material removal process using rotating cutters to produce flat surfaces, slots, and complex geometries on the workpiece.

items.title: Turning
items.description: Lathe process for producing cylindrical components with high precision using static tools on a rotating workpiece.

items.title: Grinding
items.description: Surface finishing process using grinding wheels to achieve extreme surface finish and final dimensional accuracy.

items.title: Cutting
items.description: Material cutting process using various methods to obtain the desired size and shape.

items.title: Fabrication
items.description: Fabrication process to produce components with advanced technology.
